scope: CV079B17S2D keeps the CV079B17S2C four-color common time-axis markers and fixes the narrow-screen Y-axis title overflow by left-anchoring SVG text aspect correction and applying only a minimal title inset. Plot margins, common time-to-X geometry, historical values, physical reconstruction, residuals, CSV columns, and report content remain unchanged.

historical_relation_guide.meaning: Endpoint clocks and values are historical; intermediate values are a visual relation guide.

reconstruction_line.meaning: Conditional reconstruction constrained by the same Experiment I source table. It is not a uniquely validated physical history.

sensitivity_band.meaning: Deterministic beta sensitivity; not uncertainty or confidence interval.

untimed_extreme_marker.reason: Untimed extrema have no historical clock and cannot appear on the clock axis.

residual_audit.comparison: model versus eight printed direct clock/division readings from the same source table

record_order_lane.historical_claim: Values and printed order only; no pseudo time.
record_order_lane.label: sequence_number_and_value

excluded: report layout, wording, and print pagination

mobile_readability.plot_width_priority: portrait horizontal panel padding reduced to 4 CSS px per side; adaptive plot gutters use 38 CSS px left and 4 CSS px right

interpretation.consistent_label_ja: 記録の細かさ0.1目盛以内
interpretation.observer_heading_ja: 実験I 当時の観測記録と計算結果の比較

observer_language_policy.english_usage: retain only identifiers, standard abbreviations, and parenthetical technical references

time_axis_display.playback_behavior: known transition windows normal speed; unresolved intervals accelerated 18x only in folded mode
time_axis_display.fold_marker_required: visible whenever folded mode is selected, including idle, so geometry does not change after replay starts

folded_width_allocation.waveform_width_priority: numeric Y labels use only the minimum gutter; axis title overlays the non-data top strip

time_axis_display.waiting_state: same segment boundaries, omission band, fold marks, grid, and clock labels as running/completed; no waveform, current marker, transition cue, or equilibrium cue

folded_x_mapping.mapping_basis: ordered segment layout generated from rendered CSS width
folded_x_mapping.boundary_rule: each adjacent segment shares one computed boundary coordinate
folded_x_mapping.experiment_i_rule: 10:05 is the omitted segment left edge; 12:00:48 is its right edge and the first post-omission waveform boundary

time_axis_display.boundary_label_alignment: 10:05 and 12:00:48 are read from the Experiment I time-axis data and mapped by the same segment layout used by the omitted band, grid, markers, current position, and waveform paths.
time_axis_display.configuration_model: ordered arbitrary normal/omitted segments per observation set; sets without configuration use one full-time normal segment
time_axis_display.coordinate_basis: CSS rendered width determines margins and omitted widths once; the result is converted to SVG viewBox coordinates and shared by all draw elements
time_axis_display.normal_segment_width: remaining plot width allocated in proportion to actual historical duration after compact adaptive gutters and omission widths
time_axis_display.omitted_segment_width: 8% of rendered width, normally clamped to 44-64 CSS px and compressed only when required by narrow screens or multiple omitted segments
time_axis_display.label_collision_policy: dataset candidates with priority; omission boundaries and observation endpoints use boundary-directed anchors; lower-priority labels are removed or placed on the secondary row
time_axis_display.full_axis_implementation: same engine and segment data with omitted-width compression disabled; actual historical duration remains proportional
time_axis_display.record_policy_in_omitted_segment: hidden for Experiment I; future sets may choose hidden, boundary, or inside in configuration
time_axis_display.full_axis_unobserved_interval: wave remains disconnected; only subtle dashed boundary lines and an unobserved label are shown, never a filled omission-style band
time_axis_display.cache_policy: HTML appends the current build query to CSS and JS resources to prevent mixed old/new draw paths in local Safari server caches
time_axis_display.draw_connection_audit: all waveform paths, direct markers, current indicators, grid, labels, omitted bands, fold marks, and event lines resolve X through the same cached layout

mass_motion_display.unresolved_interval: state card stating no observation record
